reasons: The cited text supports the compliant claim: 24.1 gives Customer a consent-free right to assign to an Affiliate or M&A successor on notice only, matching the preferred position's carve-out (confirmed by the deterministic check).

24.2 restricts Vendor asymmetrically (assignment, delegation of material performance, and change-of-control transfer all require Customer consent) and bars assignment to a direct Customer competitor absent Customer consent, so Customer retains a veto; 24.4 expressly negates any Vendor termination, suspension, repricing, Fee acceleration, or service-reduction right on Customer's change of control, eliminating the walk-away triggers.

The rationale's cross-checks are consistent with the supplied text: 24.3's consent requirement is scoped to "other assignments" and the void clause applies only to assignments contrary to the Section, so neither cuts back 24.1; 13.3 reinforces transferability of licence rights to an Affiliate or successor under Section 24.

No redline or counterparty comment is expected or present for a compliant finding, and none is warranted here; the finding is appropriately retained as internal evidence rather than a negotiation issue.
